name_cn: 石家庄冀誉纺织有限公司
main_products: Grey fabric, finished woven fabric (poly-cotton), sized yarn, yarn, some garments
woven_evidence: Its website reports 100+ automatic looms making about 15M m of grey woven fabric a year.

canton_fair.evidence_note: The Shijiazhuang government report on the 139th Canton Fair names it among the yarn and fabric exhibitors showing new functional yarns and fabrics.

notes: Its site describes a mixed production and trading model, and its finished-fabric menu includes bedding fabric. Layer 2 should confirm how much of its range is apparel fabric.
